prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production Unity 2D top-down game sprite. Match the reference ONLY in art style: smooth dark plum outlines, soft matte shading, rounded pastel cozy shapes. Clear readable at small game scale on dark wooden floor. Actual alpha transparent background, centered isolated contiguous shape, 12 percent transparent padding all sides. No background, floor, shadow, text, logos, borders, extra objects, particles, eyes or face. Not pixel art, not photoreal or 3D. Subject: A plump tiny water projectile, horizontal teardrop silhouette. IMPORTANT orientation: rounded broad leading head at the RIGHT, a short pointed taper at the LEFT, aligned perfectly along horizontal X axis. Pale aqua body, muted blue teal outline and a single broad creamy highlight. One droplet only. No detached drops or glow.
